title: 🎃Spooky Springs Reminder & Update
author: Jonathan Hill

body:
Hey everyone. Here to give a quick reminder and update on Spooky Springs and a few general updates.

🍄‍🟫Spooky Springs

  • Reminder that there's still about 12 days for Spooky Springs, which is plenty of time to make a build. A number of plots are still open!

  • We've also decided to add some prizes. These are in addition to the standard and special prizes already announced:

    • 🎃The top 3 builds will earn the Pumpkin Mask charm, which grants -20% detection range and stops Endermen from angering at your sight.

    • 🍬ALL entrants will receive the Treat Bag charm, which allows mobs to sometimes drop Halloween treats even outside of the season.

  • We recently doubled the build contest entry prize to 50k silver and 4 Badges of Valor. A simple Spooky Springs build gets you both of those and a Treat Bag!

📝General Updates

  • 🤖The Moments runic spell now progresses Copper Golem oxidization. It takes many casts to fully oxidize them, but it's far faster than the hours it takes otherwise.

  • 🧙 Fixed some Pointy Hat trades not giving the correct number of potions.

  • 🐈‍⬛ Fixed some special Halloween spawns appearing in unexpected areas.
